upgrades.name: Overwinter
upgrades.summary: First network upgrade — transaction format v3, replay protection, expiry height.

upgrades.name: Sapling
upgrades.summary: Shielded payments usable in practice — Sapling circuit, Bech32 addresses, HD wallets.

upgrades.name: Blossom
upgrades.summary: Halved block target spacing and related consensus changes.

upgrades.name: Heartwood
upgrades.summary: Shielded coinbase and relaxed Sapling signature verification.

upgrades.name: Canopy
upgrades.summary: New development fund and Sapling binding-signature enforcement.

upgrades.name: NU5
upgrades.summary: Orchard (Halo 2), transaction format v5, unified addresses.

upgrades.name: NU6
upgrades.summary: End of the Canopy dev fund, direct discretionary grant funding, transparent-pool cap.

upgrades.name: NU6.1
upgrades.summary: introduces the Community-Governance Panel and a change to the spend restricting rules.

upgrades.name: NU6.2
upgrades.summary: Consensus bug fixes and the Orchard temporary vulnerability mitigation.

upgrades.name: NU6.3
upgrades.summary: Adds a new signature scheme for ZIP 244 coinsights? See ZIP 258 for scope.

upgrades.name: NU7
upgrades.summary: Proposed/future upgrade. ZIP 254 (Deployment of NU7) was withdrawn; successors are in draft.
